After undefeated regular season, Miami men's basketball team awarded spot in March Madness tournament Updated: 11:19 AM EDT Mar 16, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ After a historic season that saw the team put up an undefeated regular season record, Miami University is set to play in the 2026 March Madness tournament.The RedHawks are ranked as a No. 11 seed and will face off against Southern Methodist University for a play-in spot during the First Four round in Dayton on March 18.The winner will then play in the Round of 64 for the right to take on Tennessee in Philadelphia on March 20.This marks the RedHawks' first appearance in the tournament since 2007. It is also the first time that any MAC team has earned an at-large bid to March Madness since the RedHawks did it in 1999.Miami went 31-0 in the regular season this year. However, the team would lose their very next game in the MAC conference tournament this past Thursday, falling 87-83 to Massachusetts. Ultimately, Akron would emerge as this year's MAC champions.Earlier this week, the RedHawks finished their season as the No. 20 ranked team in the country in AP's Top 25 poll.Despite this, early betting odds indicate that Miami is expected to face an uphill battle to get past unranked SMU for the right to take on Tennessee, with the RedHawks opening as -7.5 point underdogs.Miami'sticipation makes them the sole team in the immediate Greater Cincinnati area to make it to March Madness this year.Additionally, the Miami women's basketball team will also be part of the women's March Madness tournament after winning the MAC championship on Saturday. For their first round, they are expected to take on West Virginia at their home arena in Morgantown on March 21. It will mark the first time that the Miami women have played in the March Madness tournament since 2008.A tip-off time has not yet been set for the RedHawks' game against SMU.
